profile.headline: Fullstack Developer
profile.summary:
I am a Fullstack Developer with solid working knowledge of Javascript and the NERD Stack and great enthusiasm for front-end technologies and design. From coding up web forums in highschool to acquiring a BS in Computer Science, a great part of my life has always been immersed in coding and the web. 

After graduating, I decided to start an online store with a friend and became its sole developer and core designer, mainly working with front-end programming and graphic programs such as Photoshop and Illustrator. Building the store led me to discover my passion for web development and enter The Grace Hopper program at Fullstack Academy where I  built and worked on fully functional web apps with front-end and back-end frameworks, entire eCommerce platforms, games and blockchain technology.  

Github: https://github.com/OczaneM/

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Worked with the team on the continuous development and maintenance of multiple analytics platforms after their launch while providing backend support. Lead the development of new features and spearheaded the adoption of new technologies and testing strategies into our codebase.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description: Founding fullstack developer in the creation of multiple analytics platforms. Involved in planning, design, development, and testing of ui components.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Swinnis is a young line of amusing, unique designs that we created to express our excitement for sports. On the surface, it's an online store dedicated to sport lovers but, underneath it all, it's our primary tool to spread laughter between friends and families who share similar sport interests.

As its only technical support, I am in charge of providing continued maintenance and development of bug fixes and patches for any of its integrated web apps, ensuring 100% up-time of business operations.

 I also process, sometimes produce, and vectorize the store's graphic content. I am currently mostly using programs such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Wacom Tablet, and Inkscape.

https://swinnis.com/

positions.title: IT Summer Intern
positions.description:
My main focus during my internship at Actavis was to provide base level IT support to non-technical personnel within the business.

Whilst I slowly integrated into the workflow between the company's Business Specialists and its IT Department, I also installed software, managed call-flow, modified and repaired hardware, and resolved technical issues on Windows desktops.

positions.title: C++ Instructor
positions.description:
I had co-started a basic C++ Programming Course based on the self-initiative to improve own understanding of the language in the second year of my CS Program.

It was a 3-month-long course where me and a university colleague taught weekly internal programming classes to more than 10 students of varied backgrounds.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in a pilot program launched by Google to ignite interest in Computer Science for K-12 students. We mentored and taught high schoolers on how to program with Python and always secured a steady flow of more than 20 students every session.

projects.title: Pure JS To-do
projects.description: A simple, stylish, responsive web app for creating tasks built solely with CSS, HTML, and Javascript. The main purpose of the project was to solidify front-end framework concepts through the use of Javascript to manipulate the DOM as well as explore HTML5 Javascript APIs.

projects.title: Modern Dino
projects.description:
A real-time interactive online store with integrated user authentication and data persistence through sessions where you can browse and buy a variety of products for all your modern dinosaur needs. 

Developed on a Linux OS using Node.js, Express, Sequelize, PostgreSQL, React, Redux, Stripe, Mocha and Chai

Implemented the store's home, products, and cart components as well as their front-to-back-end routing and database models.

 Designed and executed the UI using Flexbox and Bootstrap.
